## Independent scope and authority

The reviewer authored none of the engineering, proposal, Design, plan or tests. Prior participation was assessment only. Inspected the complete M5 range, current primary context, approved Proposal r7/Design r6/Delivery r3 and evidence release-m5-implementation-r1. The governing plan and four-member model package remain exact. Delivery's contextual preimplementation wrapper/tests intentionally differ after the authorized slice; its allocation approval relies on unchanged plan/Design and explicit prospective removal, not continued wrapper presence. Prior judgments retain their subjects and meaning. No engineering, activity or work mutation is made here.

## Implementation and protection

The executable diff removes exactly the 24-line forwarding alias and the 20-line test dedicated to that withdrawn alias. validate-release.py is unchanged; the selector's canonical --recorded-source-auto command is unchanged. Actual recorded-commit validation and distinct error, metadata, missing/stale/malformed resource tests remain. Remaining references are selector impact recognition and its test, plus the historical v0.1.3 test-spec list explicitly dispositioned by Design r6. No active runtime caller remains in inspected scripts/workflow/packages/release guidance. The added selector comment accurately distinguishes deleted-path impact coverage from supported executable compatibility.

The existing real candidate integration fixture now explicitly detaches HEAD and creates main with checkout -B before its reviewed fixture commit. Both commands target only the isolated temporary clone. This corrects the demonstrated environmental assumption without changing source authority, candidate generation, protected validation, publication code or workflow permissions. It retains the actual candidate/archive/bundled metadata/npm/CLI and failure/recovery assertions. Forcing detached input locally makes the formerly hosted-only condition reproducible; it does not bypass checks or suppress the failure. Script deletion requires a committed snapshot so clone inventory reflects absence; the final range proof uses the actual committed deletion.

REL-SR-06/08/09/14/19/21/22 and M5/TG09 are satisfied at this milestone boundary: canonical and standalone protection is retained, only approved compatibility is withdrawn, actual integrated proof exercises the corrected environment, and new candidate evidence covers changed identity-bearing scripts. M1–M4 ownership/authorization logic is not rewritten. No further wrapper removal is inferred from thinness or age.

## Actual proof and applicability

Independently ran python scripts/test-adapter-distribution.py AdapterDistributionTests.test_release_ci_validation_uses_recorded_source_commit_for_v0_1_5 AdapterDistributionTests.test_release_ci_recorded_source_mode_preserves_release_metadata_validation: two passed in 0.535s. The second intentionally observes metadata-validation failure and requires propagation; its printed Gate C error is expected negative evidence. Independently initialized a temporary Git repository: detached branch -M main returned 128; checkout -B main returned 0 and symbolic-ref HEAD was refs/heads/main. Inspected unchanged engineering suffix after 6510de02; no script/workflow/package/model/plan differences remain.

Author evidence preserves hosted run 34415416771 failure and actual prior integration reproduction (15 cases, one error in 5.662s), then the corrected complete final-range run. Read /tmp/release-m5-final-ci.log: bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base eab1f8041f076312737ac1466a78c9a8de639445 --head 6510de02beedd35cfe225c62899bdb91eb6ee301 passed all 15 selected checks, including actual release regression132.70s, adapters24.62s, selector61.38s, lifecycle120.26s and CLI23.28s. This rebuilds the actual candidate after deletion; older final runtime evidence is not substituted. Current retained metadata/resource and selector suites execute, rather than merely checking names. No engineering changed during or after that run. Independent review inspects this owning evidence; it does not claim to have rerun the full suite itself.

Model/prose/scoped-record checks accompany author evidence. Current readability is reported as passed with168 advisories by the author; those are not semantic approval or a savings metric. The original hosted failure remains failed. Replacement hosted CI has not yet run and must be observed on the authorized pushed head; local composed proof establishes no hosted setup or real release success.

| Item | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spec alignment | pass | Exact r6 standalone disposition and M5 scope; no broader deletion. |
| Test coverage | pass | Only withdrawn delegation test removed; canonical positive and distinct negative checks retained and executed. |
| Edge cases | pass | Detached input forced in real composed fixture; deletion-aware selection retained. |
| Error handling | pass | Canonical metadata failure still propagates; Git failures remain checked. |
| Architecture boundaries | pass | Canonical validator/shared helpers remain owners; test setup alone changes. |
| Compatibility | pass | Explicit alias withdrawal with canonical replacement; historical judgments unchanged. |
| Security/privacy | pass | Branch reset confined to temporary clone; no credential or publication change. |
| Derived artifact currency | pass | Committed deletion included in newly built final candidate proof. |
| Unrelated changes | pass | Four bounded script paths plus approved governance/evidence amendments. |
| Validation evidence | pass | Exact new range and preserved earlier failure; hosted replacement not overclaimed. |

## Handoff

Return M5 approval to route. This milestone assessment does not replace a fresh complete final diff/cross-milestone Code Review or distinct Verify. No final adoption, branch/PR readiness, external permission or publication success is claimed.
independence_basis: Independent nonauthor assessed full M5 slice and actual retained proof, with separate canonical tests and detached Git reproduction; no engineering/routing authorship.
